protocolSteps.title: CM5 Chip Docking & Equilibrating
protocolSteps.instruction: Dock certified CM5 optical sensor chip into Biacore T200. Prime system 3 times with filtered degassed MilliQ H2O at 25°C.
protocolSteps.notes: Pressure steady at 1.4 bar, baseline stabilized within ±0.2 RU.

protocolSteps.title: Surface Activation via EDC/NHS
protocolSteps.instruction: Inject 1:1 mixture of 0.4 M EDC and 0.1 M NHS for 420 seconds at flow rate 10 µL/min to activate carboxymethyl dextran matrix.
protocolSteps.notes: Delta RU = +320 RU activation peak observed on channel 2.

protocolSteps.title: KRAS G12D Recombinant Protein Immobilization
protocolSteps.instruction: Dilute His-tagged KRAS G12D (10 µg/mL in 10 mM Sodium Acetate pH 5.0). Inject for 360 seconds targeting 1200 RU density.

protocolSteps.title: PROTAC Degrader BSC-401 Multi-cycle Titration
protocolSteps.instruction: Inject BSC-401 in two-fold serial dilutions (0.39 nM to 50 nM) at 45 µL/min. Association: 180s, Dissociation: 600s.
protocolSteps.notes: Rapid 1:1 Langmuir binding kinetics recorded without bulk refractive index anomalies.

experimentVersions.conclusion: Initial runs confirm sub-10 nM binding with acceptable mass transfer limitation bounds.
experimentVersions.changeSummary: Initial experimental design and baseline SPR protocol commitment.

protocolSteps.title: CM5 Chip Docking & Equilibrating
protocolSteps.instruction: Dock certified CM5 optical sensor chip into Biacore T200. Prime system 3 times with filtered degassed MilliQ H2O at 25°C.
protocolSteps.notes: Pressure steady at 1.4 bar, baseline stabilized within ±0.2 RU.

protocolSteps.title: Surface Activation via EDC/NHS
protocolSteps.instruction: Inject 1:1 mixture of 0.4 M EDC and 0.1 M NHS for 420 seconds at flow rate 10 µL/min to activate carboxymethyl dextran matrix.
protocolSteps.notes: Delta RU = +320 RU activation peak observed on channel 2.

protocolSteps.title: KRAS G12D Recombinant Protein Immobilization
protocolSteps.instruction: Dilute His-tagged KRAS G12D (10 µg/mL in 10 mM Sodium Acetate pH 5.0). Inject for 360 seconds targeting 1200 RU density.

protocolSteps.title: PROTAC Degrader BSC-401 Multi-cycle Titration
protocolSteps.instruction: Inject BSC-401 in two-fold serial dilutions (0.39 nM to 50 nM) at 45 µL/min. Association: 180s, Dissociation: 600s.
protocolSteps.notes: Rapid 1:1 Langmuir binding kinetics recorded without bulk refractive index anomalies.

protocolSteps.title: Regeneration with 10 mM Glycine-HCl pH 2.2
protocolSteps.instruction: Pulse 10 µL of glycine regeneration solution at 30 µL/min for 30 seconds between compound concentrations. Re-equilibrate in running buffer for 300s.
protocolSteps.notes: Surface fully regenerated; baseline drift < 1.2 RU across all 8 injection cycles.

experimentVersions.conclusion: Regeneration protocol verified. Steady baseline maintained. Apparent KD determined to be 8.42 ± 0.35 nM.
experimentVersions.changeSummary: Added Step 5 regeneration pulse protocol and updated steady-state kinetic evaluation parameters.

experimentVersions.title: Validation of Cryopreservation Protocol for T-Cell Viability at -196°C Liquid Nitrogen
experimentVersions.objective: Establish Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) compliant vitrification SOP achieving >90% cell viability post-cryo preservation.
experimentVersions.hypothesis: Reduced DMSO (5%) formulation with 50 mM trehalose preserves membrane integrity superior to standard 10% DMSO without cytotoxicity.

protocolSteps.title: Cell Count and Viability Baseline Assessment
protocolSteps.instruction: Harvest expanded CD19-targeting CAR-T cells at day 12. Determine cell viability by automated acridine orange/propidium iodide (AO/PI) fluorescence.
protocolSteps.notes: Initial viable cell density: 4.82 x 10^6 cells/mL with 97.4% initial viability.

protocolSteps.title: Formulation Resuspension & Controlled-Rate Freezing
protocolSteps.instruction: Resuspend cell pellet into chilled FORM-CRYO-101 at 1 x 10^7 cells/mL. Transfer to 2 mL cryovials. Freeze at controlled rate -1°C/min down to -80°C.
protocolSteps.notes: Controlled cooling chamber ramp confirmed linear within ±0.15°C margin.

protocolSteps.title: Liquid Nitrogen Vapor Phase Storage & Thaw Analysis
protocolSteps.instruction: Submerge in LN2 vapor phase (-196°C) for 72 hours. Thaw in 37°C water bath for 90s, dilute with pre-warmed media, and assay post-thaw recovery.
protocolSteps.notes: Post-thaw recovery: 94.2% viable cells after 24 hours in culture.

experimentVersions.conclusion: Formulation FORM-CRYO-101 demonstrated 94.2% viability, passing GLP release threshold (>85%). Protocol certified for Phase I clinical material.
experimentVersions.changeSummary: Finalized and validated standard operating protocol with multi-lot replicates.

protocolSteps.title: Chiral Stationary Phase Column Conditioning
protocolSteps.instruction: Mount Chiralpak AD-H column (250 x 4.6 mm, 5 µm). Equilibrate with 90:10 n-Hexane/Isopropanol at 1.0 mL/min for 45 min at 25°C.

protocolSteps.title: Sample Derivatization & Autosampler Loading
protocolSteps.instruction: Dissolve 2.0 mg biocatalytic transaminase reaction mixture in 1.0 mL mobile phase. Filter through 0.22 µm PTFE syringe filter.
protocolSteps.notes: Clear colorless solution prepared in HPLC vial #14.
